signals.entity: GELDSERVICE AUSTRIA (GSA) Logistik fuer Wertgestionierung und Transportkoordination G.m.b.H.
signals.signal: OPEN/IN-EVALUATION: GSA is procuring 'Kombinierte Ein- und Auszahlungsgeraete fuer effiziente und nachhaltige Bargeld- und Gutscheinlogistik' (combined deposit-and-withdrawal devices = cash and coin RECYCLERS) - TED 305531-2026, CPV 30123200 (automatic cash dispensers), estimated value EUR 9,100,000 excl. VAT over 5 years, negotiated procedure with prior publication, minimum 3 candidates invited, unlimited-term contract for devices AND maintenance. Award weights: Banknotenrecycling 100 pts, Muenzrecycling 74, Muenzeinzahler & Muenzhopper 32, Allgemeines 33, Nachhaltigkeit 6, Price 245. Deadline for requests to participate was 08/06/2026 11:00; invitations to tender dispatched ~25/06/2026; contract start 02/11/2026. Delivery locations: Austria, Slovenia and Bavaria (DE), plus CH/FL/CZ/SK/HU/IT within 100 km of the Austrian border. Docs at gv.vergabeportal.at/Detail/244277.
signals.implies: This is the single largest and most directly Printec-shaped opportunity in Austria: cash/coin recyclers plus lifetime maintenance, i.e. Printec's cash automation + managed services core. The cross-border delivery scope (Slovenia, Bavaria, CEE border zone) also fits Printec's regional service footprint.
signals.followup: URGENT: establish whether Printec filed a Teilnahmeantrag by 08/06/2026. If not, pursue subcontract/service partnership with the winner and prepare for the follow-on call-offs; the framework is unlimited-term so the winner locks the estate.

signals.entity: Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB) / PSA Payment Services Austria GmbH
signals.signal: The OeNB rural-ATM framework (GZ 2024-4107, CPV 66600000, min 60 / max 120 ATMs + up to 20 relocations, 48 months from 02/06/2025) has a CONFIRMED maximum value of EUR 5,544,425.60 - TED award notice 511414-2025 states in terms that the earlier EUR 55,444,425.60 figure was a typographical error ('Tippfehler') in notice 216012-00. Original estimated value in the contract notice (TED 54963-2025, 27/01/2025) was EUR 6,644,000 excl. VAT. Winner PSA Payment Services Austria GmbH, 3 tenders received, quality 60% / price 40%.
signals.source_name: TED 511414-2025 corrective award notice (and TED 54963-2025 contract notice)
signals.implies: Resolves the value ambiguity carried in the baseline. The framework is small (EUR 5.5m), single-supplier and expires 02/06/2029 - so the volume story is the drawdown rate, not the headline.
signals.followup: Use EUR 5,544,425.60 as the authoritative ceiling in all Printec briefing material; retire the EUR 55.4m figure

signals.source_name: USP eProcurement (ausschreibungen.usp.gv.at) - OeNB GZ 2024-4107 call-off award notices
signals.implies: Answers the baseline's 'second municipality round' question: it is not a discrete second round, it is a rolling monthly-to-quarterly call-off programme. ~73% of the EUR 5.54m ceiling is consumed after 12 of 48 months.
signals.likelihood: Call-offs continue at roughly monthly cadence
signals.followup: Track each new call-off via the USP JSON API query q=Geldausgabeautomat to time the re-tender

signals.signal: OeNB reports 66 active OeNB-Bankomat ATMs as at 06/07/2026 (66th opened in Guettenbach, Burgenland; local average distance to nearest ATM fell from 4.4 km to 0.6 km), >80,000 people served, more than one new site per week since July 2025, and an explicit target of UP TO 120 OeNB ATMs by end-2026. Eligibility: municipality with no ATM and no bank branch, >=500 inhabitants, >=2 km average distance to nearest ATM, >=1 km distance reduction. PSA is the operating partner.
signals.source_name: OeNB press release 'Ein Jahr OeNB-Bankomat-Initiative' + OeNB ATM programme page
signals.implies: 66 ATMs have already consumed ~73% of the framework ceiling. Doubling to 120 by end-2026 cannot be funded from the ~EUR 1.5m headroom, so OeNB must either expand the framework or run a NEW procurement - a genuine ATM + managed-services opening for Printec within 6-18 months.
signals.likelihood: New/expanded ATM procurement highly likely within 12 months
signals.followup: Pre-position with OeNB Einkaufsmanagement and with PSA; monitor TED CPV 66600000/30123200 for Austria and the ANKOe portal

signals.signal: GSA awarded 'System BPS M Segment Upgrade inkl. geringfuegiger Hardware-Ergaenzung fuer 6 Stk. Maschinen' to Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH, EUR 615,135.40, contract 11/12/2025, CPV 48100000, negotiated procedure WITHOUT prior publication, 1 offer (also TED 856282-2025).
signals.implies: GSA operates a 6-machine G+D BPS M sorting fleet - the same platform Printec services at NBS Serbia and Banka Slovenije. Machine supply is locked to G+D; Printec's realistic angle is third-party service, spares and multivendor monitoring software.
signals.followup: Test whether GSA would ever compete BPS maintenance separately (Banka Slovenije does - see the re-issued BS sorting-maintenance tender)

signals.signal: GSA direct-awarded 'Softwareentwicklung Multi Vendor Bargeld und Gutschein Software Plattform, inkl. 4 Jahre Wartung' to Data Engineering Gesellschaft fuer Betriebsinformatik mbH (Stammzahl 9110015416480), EUR 109,200.00, contract 10/12/2025, CPV 48100000, below-threshold, 2 offers. A companion notice 'Applikationssoftware und Gutscheinverarbeitung, keine Wartung' was published the same day.
signals.implies: GSA is deliberately building a MULTI-VENDOR cash software layer - exactly Printec's multivendor cash-automation/managed-services proposition - and it explicitly pairs with the EUR 9.1m recycler procurement (both cite 'Bargeld- und Gutscheinlogistik'). It went to a small local ISV at a low value, so the strategic platform is not yet hardened.
signals.followup: Pitch Printec multivendor device software + estate monitoring to GSA alongside the recycler programme

signals.signal: GSA direct-awarded a consultancy project for 'umfassende Analyse und Optimierung der operativen Prozesse und Kostenstrukturen, inkl. Erstellung eines Standortkonzeptes' (full operating-process and cost-structure review plus a SITE/NETWORK concept) to EFESO Consulting Austria GmbH, EUR 137,000.00, duration 3 months, contract 20/04/2026, CPV 79410000, 4 offers.
signals.implies: A cost and site-network restructuring study at the national cash-cycle operator, delivered ~July 2026, is the classic precursor to automation capex and outsourcing - and it sits immediately before the EUR 9.1m recycler award. Printec should read the recycler tender and this study as one programme.
signals.followup: Ask GSA for the Standortkonzept outcome; time an automation + managed-service proposal to it

signals.signal: GSA operates 17 SCAN COIN ICP-9 coin-counting machines across SIX sites (Wien, Linz, Graz, Klagenfurt, Innsbruck, Bregenz) and direct-awarded the full-service maintenance and repair contract to GZT-Geldzaehltechnik GmbH via a voluntary ex-ante transparency notice - EUR 510,650.08, start 02/05/2025, intended to be an OPEN-ENDED contract (the '48 months' is a form artefact), CPV 50310000 + 30123600.
signals.implies: Precise map of GSA's coin estate and its service incumbent. An open-ended direct-award full-service contract is the exact structure Printec sells as managed services - and it was awarded without competition, which is contestable.
signals.likelihood: Locked for now; contestable at any equipment refresh
signals.followup: Profile GZT-Geldzaehltechnik GmbH (FN 98239w) as the key Austrian competitor; watch for a SCAN COIN ICP-9 replacement tender

signals.signal: GSA bought 'Muenzrollenverpacker fuer die Fertigung von Muenzrollen' (coin-roll packaging machines) from GZT - Geldzaehltechnik Gesellschaft m.b.H. (FN 98239w), EUR 661,057.35, contract 17/11/2025, CPV 30123630, negotiated procedure WITH prior publication - and received only ONE offer (TED 501483-2025 / 793615-2025).
signals.implies: A EUR 0.66m openly-published coin-equipment tender attracted a single bidder. The Austrian competitive field is thin - a credible foreign bidder such as Printec has room, provided it is registered on ANKOe to see notices in time.
signals.followup: Register Printec on gv.vergabeportal.at (ANKOe) for CPV 301232xx / 301236xx / 42000000 Austria

signals.signal: OeNB awarded 'Modernisierung der Banknotenbearbeitungsmaschine' to Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH, EUR 237,900.00, contract 03/11/2025, CPV 42900000, negotiated procedure WITHOUT prior publication, 1 offer (GZ 2025-3303).
signals.implies: OeNB extends the life of its existing G+D sorter rather than replacing it. No central-bank sorter replacement tender in Austria in this window - contrast HNB Croatia V-34 and Banka Slovenije.
signals.followup: Watch for an OeNB high-speed sorter REPLACEMENT (open procedure) after the modernisation life ends

signals.signal: OeBS direct-awarded 'Lieferung diverser Ersatzteile fuer Banknotenbearbeitungssysteme' to Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH, EUR 54,294.91, contract 28/05/2025, CPV 42000000, 1 offer. Note the GSA recycler tender's contact e-mail is @oebs.co.at (Print and Mint Services GmbH), i.e. OeBS runs GSA's procurement.
signals.implies: All three Austrian cash-cycle bodies (OeNB, GSA, OeBS) are a single G+D estate procured through one shared function at OeBS/Print and Mint Services. One relationship (OeBS purchasing, contact A. Riedmueller) covers the whole Austrian cash cycle.
signals.followup: Route Printec's Austrian approach through OeBS/Print and Mint Services purchasing rather than three separate buyers

signals.signal: Oesterreichische Post AG still calls off against a framework 'Automatische Kassentresore klein und gross' (automatic cash safes / teller cash-handling units) concluded on 04/08/2015 with GZT - Geldzaehltechnik Gesellschaft m.b.H.: 'AKT AST-7016 Fullservice 2025' EUR ... and 'Fullservice 2026' EUR 270,923.05 (published 19/02/2026), 'Ueberholung kleiner 5 Mio. Banknoten' EUR 128,486.26 (published 21/11/2025), plus a separate 'Ein- und Ausgabegeraet' maintenance framework of 28/11/2014 with GZT (EUR 60,487.68 top-up published 30/03/2026).
signals.source_name: USP eProcurement - Oesterreichische Post AG GZ 5100926616 / 5100905314 / 5100941750
signals.implies: Austria's post-office network (which fronts retail bank bank99) runs its branch cash automation on frameworks that are 11-12 years old, still serviced by GZT. That estate is technically obsolete and legally overdue for re-competition - a prime Printec teller-cash-recycler + managed-services target.
signals.likelihood: Re-tender plausible but not yet announced; ageing frameworks are being extended instead
signals.followup: Approach Oesterreichische Post AG / bank99 procurement on branch cash-recycler modernisation; monitor USP q=Kassentresore and q='Ein- und Ausgabegeraet'

signals.signal: OeNB direct-awarded 'Empfaengerueberpruefung (VOP - Verification of Payee) - IBAN-Abgleich' to BAWAG P.S.K., EUR 130,700.00, 48 months, contract 15/01/2026, CPV 66110000, 1 offer (GZ 2026-292).
signals.implies: Even a central bank is buying EU Instant Payments Regulation Verification-of-Payee capability as a bought-in service. Confirms live CEE demand adjacent to Printec's transaction-monitoring / fraud line, though here consumed as a bank service rather than a platform.
signals.likelihood: VOP procurement wave continues across CEE through 2026
signals.followup: Use as a demand datapoint for Printec VOP/transaction-monitoring positioning in the region

signals.signal: OeNB awarded a framework for 'Wertetransporte' - gold transports of up to five tonnes per movement from London to continental Europe - to Brink's Global Services Deutschland GmbH, EUR 433,235.00, contract 25/11/2025, CPV 60400000/60000000, negotiated with prior publication, 2 offers (GZ 2025-1733).
signals.implies: Not a Printec product line (bullion CIT), but names Brink's as OeNB's value-transport counterparty - useful channel context for Austrian cash-cycle managed services and for the CIT competitive map alongside GSA.
signals.followup: Log Brink's Global Services Deutschland as OeNB CIT partner

Versuch' (automated weighing line for coin blanks, second attempt after a failed first round), negotiated procedure, CPV 42000000, place of performance Wien AT130, submission via gv.vergabeportal.at/Detail/252147, closing 01/09/2026 10:00 CEST, dispatched 29/07/2026.
signals.implies: Mint production equipment rather than cash-handling - only marginally Printec-adjacent (coin weighing/verification). Notable mainly because it is a SECOND attempt, i.e. the first round drew no acceptable bid, so the field is open to a new entrant.

coverage_notes: Fresh run (no checkpoint existed). Target portal ausschreibungen.usp.gv.at researched EXHAUSTIVELY via a newly-discovered public JSON API (see access_issues) rather than the JS-empty list page: 25+ German search terms run (Geldausgabeautomat, Bankomat, Banknoten, Muenzen, Bargeld, Selbstbedienung, Werttransport, Geldtransport, Zaehlmaschine, Sortiermaschine, Recycler, Geldzaehl, Falschgeld, Tresor, Kassentresore, 'Ein- und Ausgabegeraet', Zahlungsterminal, Kartenzahlung, Zahlungsverkehr, Geldwaesche, Identifizierung, Automaten, Kassa, Einzahlungsautomat, bank99, Bankdienstleistungen, 'Hardware Security', Nationalbank, GELDSERVICE AUSTRIA) plus a 600-record sweep of the most recent notices. All relevant hits opened as individual tender-detail pages. Cross-checked against TED via the v3 search API (organisation-name-buyer for OeNB=101 notices and GELDSERVICE AUSTRIA=14 notices; full-text 'Geldausgabeautomaten' 2025+ =17 notices) and four TED notice PDFs extracted locally with pdfminer.six (54963-2025, 511414-2025, 305531-2026, 208117-2025). Primary-source confirmation from OeNB's own press release and ATM programme page. KEY OUTCOMES vs the brief: (a) the 'second municipality round' is a rolling call-off programme, not a discrete round - 12 call-offs mapped with exact values; (b) the EUR 372,457.40 in the baseline was ONE call-off, not the framework - the framework is EUR 5,544,425.60 and the EUR 55.4m variant is an admitted typo; (c) a previously unseen EUR 9.1m GSA cash-RECYCLER procurement was found on TED, the biggest Austrian opportunity in this beat. GENUINE GAPS: bid documents behind ANKOe (gv.vergabeportal.at) need a free supplier registration Printec does not appear to hold, so lot detail, technical specs and candidate lists for the GSA recycler tender could not be read; Austrian COMMERCIAL banks (Erste, RBI, BAWAG, Raiffeisen) are private and publish nothing on USP/TED - that absence is itself the finding, same as Croatia. No award notice yet exists for TED 305531-2026.
access_issues: BLOCKED then SOLVED: https://ausschreibungen.usp.gv.at/at.gv.bmdw.eproc-p/public/tenderlist renders its results client-side via DataTables and returns 147 KB of HTML with ZERO result rows to a plain fetch. Working route found by reading the inline DataTables config: GET https://ausschreibungen.usp.gv.at/at.gv.bmdw.eproc-p/public/api/tenderlist?draw=1&start=0&length=100&orderColumn=2&orderDir=desc&q=<term> returns clean JSON {recordsFiltered, recordsTotal, data:[[title, org, publishedDate, deadline, objectId, isNoticeFlag, ...]]}; objectId feeds /public/tender-detail?object=<id>, which IS plain-HTML fetchable. Portal holds 169,236 records, last refreshed 31/07/2026 22:35. Desktop Chrome User-Agent used on every request. Portal rate-limits (RATE_LIMIT_SEARCH_MS 1000) so requests were spaced >=1s. TED: the v3 /notices/search API rejects 'buyer-name' and 'total-value' as field names (HTTP 400) - the working field is organisation-name-buyer; notice PDFs at https://ted.europa.eu/en/notice/<id>/pdf are GET-fetchable and were extracted with pdfminer.six as documented. NOT ACCESSED: gv.vergabeportal.at (ANKOe) tender documents require supplier registration/login - logged, not bypassed. www.data.gv.at/application/usp-ausschreibungssuche-app/ returned empty content to the fetch tool (no OGD dataset confirmed); superseded by the API route above so not escalated. Claude-in-Chrome not needed on this unit.

This is the EUR 9.1m recycler opportunity and is the single highest-value document in this unit. 2) Same portal, https://gv.vergabeportal.at/Detail/252147 - Muenze Oesterreich coin-blank weighing line, closing 01/09/2026. 3) Confirm internally whether Printec (or any Printec entity) submitted a Teilnahmeantrag for TED 305531-2026 by 08/06/2026.
